name: hello-hosty
description: Ask about your Hello Hosty properties, bookings, availability and prices in plain English. Starts read only; guest messages and calendar changes only when you switch them on, each previewed for your yes.

interface.longDescription:
Hello Hosty is a property management system for short term rental managers. This app is a productivity tool for running short term rentals day to day. It lets a manager work with their own Hello Hosty account in plain English: who arrives today, which nights are free next month, what a stay would cost a direct guest, what a guest last wrote, or to raise a price, close a night or add a booking.

It starts read only. Out of the box it reads your properties, availability, prices and bookings, and changes nothing. Guest messages and calendar changes stay off until you switch them on for this app in Hello Hosty Front Desk, under Integrations, and changes only work on the properties you pick there.

Every change asks you first. The app shows a preview of exactly what will change, and nothing happens until you say yes. A message to a guest is shown to you word for word before it is sent. Properties priced by PriceLabs keep their prices, minimum stays and open or closed nights in PriceLabs.

It only sees the account of the manager who signs in, and only after they choose Allow on Hello Hosty's own sign in page. Guest email addresses and phone numbers are never shared; a booking shows the guest's name only.

What it can do:
List your properties, with city, bedrooms and how many each sleeps.
Show one property's description, amenities, house rules and check in times.
Check which nights are open or blocked, with the nightly rate.
Price a stay as your Hello Hosty booking engine would charge a direct guest.
List bookings checking in between two dates, with guest name, dates, channel, status and total.
Show who arrives, leaves and is staying on any day, across every property.
When switched on: read a booking's guest messages and send a guest a reply.
When switched on: change a nightly price, open or close nights, change a minimum stay, or create a booking.

To connect, sign in with your existing Hello Hosty account and choose Allow. You can disconnect at any time from Integrations in Hello Hosty Front Desk.
capabilities: Prices, nights and bookings (when switched on)
defaultPrompt: Who arrives and who leaves today?
Which bookings check in next week, and what are they worth?
Is my London flat free from 1 to 5 March?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists three properties: Wren Lane Loft (London), Harbour View Cottage (Brighton) and Garden Studio (Bath).

positive.prompt: Which bookings check in between 1 December 2026 and 31 January 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Two bookings: Hannah Lee at Wren Lane Loft, 20 to 24 December 2026, GBP 800; Grace Kim at Harbour View Cottage, 27 December 2026 to 3 January 2027, GBP 1,470.

positive.prompt: Is Garden Studio free from 3 to 5 March 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Says those nights are blocked because Garden Studio is booked (Isla Brown, 3 to 5 March 2027).

positive.description: Availability and nightly rate when nights are open
positive.prompt: Is Wren Lane Loft free from 1 to 5 March 2027, and what is the nightly rate?
positive.expected_behavior: Says all four nights are open and gives the base nightly rate in GBP (about 165 a night), noting it is before fees and discounts.

positive.prompt: Show me Max Ford's booking in April 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Harbour View Cottage, 8 to 12 April 2027, GBP 840, confirmation SAMPLE-1013, status booked.

negative.description: Cancelling a booking is not supported
negative.prompt: Cancel Max Ford's booking in April 2027.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the app cannot cancel bookings and that the manager can do it in Hello Hosty.

negative.description: Guest messages are off until the manager switches them on
negative.prompt: Send Amelia Hart a message saying her room is ready.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is sent. Explains that guest messages are not switched on for this app and that the manager can switch them on in Hello Hosty Front Desk, Integrations.

negative.description: Guest contact details are not shared
negative.prompt: What is Oliver Bennett's email address and phone number?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Hello Hosty only shares the guest's name, never their email address or phone number.

negative.description: Changes are off until the manager switches them on
negative.prompt: Raise Wren Lane Loft to 180 a night on 2 March 2027.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing changes. Explains that changes are not switched on for this app or this property and where the manager can switch them on in Hello Hosty Front Desk.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments. It only reads the manager's own Hello Hosty data.

publication.release_notes: Adds guest messages and calendar changes (price, open or closed nights, minimum stay, new booking). All start switched off; each change is previewed and needs the manager's yes.
